definitions.explanation: The numerical identifier assigned to a bank account, used for deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your account number.

examples.japanese: {振込|ふりこ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: An account number is needed for the bank transfer.

examples.japanese: {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I entered the wrong account number and accidentally sent the money to someone else.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential banking term. Japanese bank transfers typically require the ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧{名|めい} (bank name), ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧{名|めい} (branch name), ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦{種別|しゅべつ}→種別：15607_shubetsu⟧ (account type), and {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう} (account number).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to confirm the account number)
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧ (to enter the account number)
- {口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ (to note down the account number)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧: bank account — the account itself
- ⟦{暗証|あんしょう}{番号|ばんごう}→暗証番号：07681_anshoubangou⟧: PIN — the secret number used for authentication
